46252714.title: File:Mirror effect of the superhydrophobic surface on a copper plate.jpg

ObjectName.value: Mirror effect of the superhydrophobic surface on a copper plate

ImageDescription.value: Representation of the mirror effect due to air-water interface on the treated surface. Since the treated surface is superhydrophobic, a layer of air remains on the surface when the plate is submerged in water. After exceeding critical angle, light is reflected off the air-water interface, causing appearance of mirror.
